**Alpha test build v1.3.0-alpha.3 — one sun, two tones, every screen** for the Mahuva Kshatriya Rajput Samaj community directory. For invited testers only.

- **MVPMI-v1.3.0-alpha.3-build….apk** (same file as **mvpmi.apk**) — Android 10 or newer; connects to https://samaj.kavigsv.com. Test-signed: **uninstall the previous app first**.
- **BUILD-INFO.txt** (version, build), **SHA256SUMS.txt**.

New in this build:
- The embossed 3D sun on its own (no disc, no ring) everywhere: app icon, header, login, member page, splash, admin tiles.
- One palette on every screen: brick and saffron only — no green buttons, icons, names or notes.
- Tap the sun in the directory header to see Mataji (the splash); "Enter Directory" or Back returns.
- My Profile uses the same sun-crowned card as Member Details; options are one menu card.
- Less empty space: no band above the header on Pixel phones, tighter text-size card, compact admin tiles; notifications sit in a card.
- Download page and file name show version and build; Settings shows them too.

Tested: 138 server tests and the full browser checklist.
